name: @agentick/compiler-react-next
description: React adapter for the Agentick v2 JSX-template compiler. Uses react-reconciler with a minimal host config exposed as `createHostConfig(deps)` (the seam reconciler-react-next extends for reactivity). `compileToTree(element, opts)` mounts, renders (react-reconciler awaits Suspense natively), walks the committed `HostInstance` tree through compiler-next's intrinsic helpers, unmounts, returns `RenderedTree`. `render(element, opts)` composes that with the formatter pipeline for a string. Reactive-only intrinsics (`<Tool>`, `<MCP>`, channels) emit effects that the compiler rejects — reconciler-react-next swaps in handlers that route through HookBridges. See ADR 39.
author: Ryan Lindgren
